T-CASE-1.action: Set 37 C; start 30 s in Time Control; reset and repeat in Temp Control, holding sensor below target 5 s then injecting readiness.

T-CASE-1.pass_condition: Setting target enables control within 1 s; Time Control counts immediately; Temp Control does not decrement before ready and counts afterward. Clock discrepancy <=0.1 s virtual time.
T-CASE-1.note: Benchmark test tolerances and event timing, not manufacturer thermal or physical performance.

T-CASE-2.action: Hold Start/Stop 2 s, observe 5 s, resume.
T-CASE-2.observable: Timer, thermal enable and stationary block transform.
T-CASE-2.pass_condition: Timer unchanged within 0.1 s during pause, resumes within 1 s; thermal enable remains true; no autonomous block orbit or rotation is introduced.
T-CASE-2.note: Benchmark test tolerances and event timing, not manufacturer thermal or physical performance.

T-LOAD.condition: No errors, resources resolved and all states finite.
